name: AGC-071 -- Obfuscated Command Line
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Ali. | AGC-071: 3 non-encoded obfuscation methods (string-concat, char-code, backtick). 4 EID 1 events. No -EncodedCommand. Distinct from AGC-013. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Medium.

techniques.comment: AGC-071: 3 non-encoded command obfuscation methods: (1) cmd.exe set+%var% concatenation, (2) PowerShell [char] code construction, (3) PowerShell backtick insertion. 4 Sysmon EID 1 events captured obfuscated CommandLines.
